events.title: 볼턴 원더러스 move into their new 27,500-seat Reebok Stadium after 102 years at Burnden Park , and draw 0–0 with 에버턴 in the league in their first game there. This result would be pivotal in the end of season positions. 에버턴 survived on goal difference to 볼턴 원더러스, who had a clear goal disallowed as the officials failed to see the ball cross the goal-line.

There are no major football matches as the entire Football League programme is moved to the previous Friday or the following Sunday on the day of the funeral of Diana, Princess of Wales (there were no Premier League matches scheduled because of international fixtures).
윔블던 continue their tradition of surprise wins over big clubs by defeating 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 3–1 on Tyneside .
Two resurgent sides, 블랙번 로버스 and 리즈 유나이티드, battle it out in a thrilling Premier League at Ewood Park in which the visitors triumph 4–3.
케빈 키건 returns to football as 풀럼 FC 's "Chief Operating Officer", working in conjunction with new Head Coach Ray Wilkins .
맨체스터 유나이티드 captain Roy Keane suffers knee ligament damage against 리즈 유나이티드 in a FA Premier League 1–0 defeat at Elland Road and is ruled out for the rest of the season.

September ends with 아스널 as Premier League leaders, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 second. The previous month-end leaders 블랙번 로버스 have slipped into fifth place, while 레스터 시티 (without a top division league title to their name) currently occupy third place and are just a single point off the top spot, and 첼시 occupy fourth place. A terrible run of form has pushed 사우샘프턴 into bottom place, while 반즐리's reasonable start to their first top division season has given way to a series of heavy defeats and they now occupy the next lowest position in the league. The final place in the relegation zone is occupied by 셰필드 웬즈데이. 노팅엄 포리스트 continue to lead the way in Division One, with surprise promotion contenders 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 now second. QPR have crept into the playoff zone at the expense of 포츠머스 (who have slumped to 19th). 브래드퍼드 시티, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 스윈던 타운 complete the top six.
